title: MLEADERSTYLE leader-line weight writer domain

scope.operation: Validate group-92 leaderLineWeight against the DXF lineweight domain before direct MLEADERSTYLE output.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 maps group 92 to leader line weight. Autodesk identifies the MLEADERSTYLE setter parameter as AcDb::LineWeight and publishes the exact LineWeight enum values; kLnWtByDIPs (-4) is for internal use only.
scope.claim_boundary: Group-92 direct-writer domain and emitted values only; no lineweight display/plot or whole-document support claim.

implementation: Reject values outside the 27 published DXF lineweight values before emitting the MLEADERSTYLE record.
Preserve each valid signed integer group-92 wire value exactly.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.valid_domain: All 27 published DXF lineweight values are accepted and emitted exactly in both encodings.
evidence.refusal: Each invalid value preserves a destination sentinel and leaves the caller field unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries with a corrected valid value; output contains exact group 92.
evidence.matrix: 27 valid values × two encodings, plus six invalid values × two encodings with destination-safe refusal and same-adapter retry.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE integer fields, source-presence profiles, dependencies, versions and native semantics remain open.
